notes.title: Update 1: Bugfixes / Quality of life
notes.content:
Here is what this first small update holds:

[b]- Gadgets behavior should be more consistent.[/b] You will no longer throw molotovs into the void.
[b]- Boss projectiles will be destroyed if they hit you.[/b] A single projectile will no longer be able to hit you multiple times.
[b]- Multiple small fixes and tweaks.
[/b]
We are working on more bugfixes, QoL changes and visual polish as we speak.
